title: Dr. Arwa Botanical Hair Regrowth Serum
tagline: Natural follicle energizer for acute hairfall, thinning & patchy scalp
description: Formulated with potent botanical extracts and homeopathic actives, this lightweight non-greasy serum nourishes the roots, stimulates dormant hair follicles, and reduces hair fall within 4-6 weeks of regular application.
benefits: Stops excess hair fall and breakage within 4 weeks
Stimulates dormant follicles for new baby hair growth
Improves hair density, thickness and scalp circulation
100% steroid-free, paraben-free and safe for daily use
howToUse: Apply 1-2 ml directly on clean, dry scalp using the dropper. Gently massage with fingertips for 2-3 minutes. Leave overnight or for at least 3 hours before washing. Use 4-5 times a week.
ingredients: Arnica Montana, Jaborandi, Rosemary Extract, Bhringraj, Redensyl Botanical Complex, Vitamin E, Purified Aqua.

title: Dr. Arwa Glow & Radiance Face Elixir
tagline: Advanced antioxidant treatment for hyperpigmentation, dark spots & dull skin
description: A clinically curated gentle face elixir that fades stubborn pigmentation, acne marks, and uneven skin tone while imparting a healthy natural glow. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone skin.
benefits: Visibly fades dark spots, melasma and post-acne blemishes
Enhances natural skin luminosity and smooth texture
Protects skin barrier against environmental pollution
Non-comedogenic, fast absorbing and deeply hydrating
howToUse: After cleansing, dispense 3-4 drops onto face and neck. Gently pat until absorbed. Follow with your regular moisturizer or sunscreen. Use twice daily (morning & night).
ingredients: Berberis Aquifolium Extract, Rosehip Oil, Niacinamide 5%, Licorice Root, Saffron Extract, Hyaluronic Acid.

title: Dr. Arwa Scalp Revitalizing Herbal Hair Oil
tagline: Traditional slow-infused therapeutic oil for deep nourishment & dandruff control
description: Prepared by traditional slow decoction of 14 Ayurvedic & Homeopathic herbs in cold-pressed virgin coconut and sesame oils. Eliminates persistent dandruff, soothes itchy scalp, and deeply strengthens hair roots.
benefits: Relieves chronic dandruff and dry flaking scalp
Strengthens hair shafts from root to tip
Calms mental stress and promotes deep restful sleep
Free of mineral oils, artificial fragrances and sulfates
howToUse: Warm a small quantity of oil between palms. Massage thoroughly into the scalp and along hair strands. Keep on for at least 2 hours or overnight. Wash with a mild herbal shampoo 2-3 times a week.
ingredients: Cold Pressed Coconut Oil, Black Sesame Oil, Rosemary, Fenugreek (Methi), Neem, Amla, Brahmi, Camphor.
